description: Source code for quantized tensor advanced indexing operations in PyTorch, including kernel dispatch definitions, utility functions for index operations, and implementations of masked fill and index put for quantized tensors on CPU and CUDA.

methods.name: make_index_put_iterator
methods.description: Creates a TensorIterator configured for index put operations with broadcasting and overlap checks.

methods.name: masked_fill_impl_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Implements masked fill for quantized tensors on CPU.

methods.name: masked_fill__quantized_cpu
methods.description: Public API for masked fill on quantized CPU tensors, checks scheme and propagates names.

methods.name: masked_fill__quantized_cuda
methods.description: Public API for masked fill on quantized CUDA tensors, checks device and calls implementation.

methods.name: _index_put_impl_quantized_cpu_
methods.description: Implementation of index put for quantized tensors on CPU, with overlap and device checks.

methods.name: _index_put_impl_quantized_cuda_
methods.description: Implementation of index put for quantized tensors on CUDA, with overlap, device, and deterministic checks.
